name: Telangana

nextRevision.basis: G.O.Ms. No. 6 of 30 May 2026 has the Commissioner of Labour declare a cost of living allowance every 1 April and 1 October, from the state consumer price index for the half-years ending December and June. None had been declared under the order when we checked on 24 November 2026, including the one due from 1 October 2026.

sources.title: Revision of minimum wages under the Code on Wages, 2019: one table of basic rates by zone and skill for all employments
sources.authority: Labour, Employment, Training and Factories Department, Government of Telangana
sources.legalBasis: Code on Wages, 2019, sections 6 to 8. In force from 1 June 2026, in supersession of every notification under the Minimum Wages Act, 1948, and, in its words, subject to the outcome of writ petitions and contempt cases then pending before the Telangana High Court. Published in the Telangana Gazette Extraordinary of 1 June 2026 (No. 111-A, as cited in filings before the High Court; the issue is not on the state's e-Gazette portal). A trade union's public interest case asks the High Court to suspend it; when we checked on 24 November 2026 no order had suspended it.
sources.via: The government's copy is on the Government Orders portal (goir.telangana.gov.in), which serves files only through its search form, with no address to link. This copy, published by United Consultancy, a compliance firm, is the same file byte for byte (SHA-256 matches the file the portal served on 24 November 2026).

tables.title: All employments
tables.appliesTo: Every employment in Schedules I and II of the order: 76 employments, including any manufacturing process in a factory, chemicals and pharmaceuticals, engineering, construction, security services, shops and commercial establishments, and hotels. Powerlooms, garments, spinning mills, brick kilns, beedi and handloom weaving are left to a separate committee. Trainees get 75% of their category's rate, but not less than the unskilled rate.
tables.dailyRule: The order divides the monthly rate by 26, a figure that includes the rest day. Pay is rounded to the nearest 50 paise.
tables.vdaNote: The order links these basic rates to the state consumer price index at 443 points (2001 = 100) and adds ₹33.86 a month for each point above that, declared by the Commissioner of Labour from 1 April and 1 October. No VDA had been declared under the order when we checked, so the figures here are the basic rates alone.

groups.title: All 76 scheduled employments
employments: Offices of religious and social institutions, such as temples, churches and mosques
Amusement parks, water theme parks and commercial entertainment or recreation parks
Mobile tower maintenance, TV cable networks and allied data or signal processing
Construction of projects, including dams and multipurpose projects
Construction and maintenance of roads and buildings
Cement concrete pipes and cement ware (excluding stoneware pipes)
Soft drinks and aerated water units
Hospitals, nursing homes, clinics and dispensaries
Toddy tapping, including conveyance and selling
Rice mills, flour mills and dal mills, including roller flour mills
Steel mills and steel re-rolling mills
Woollen carpet making and shawl weaving
Wood working, including wooden furniture (excluding timbering)
Professions: chartered and cost accountants, auditors, tax consultants and advocates' clerks
Printing presses, including litho and offset printing
Motion picture industry, including production, distribution and publicity
Marketing societies, consumer co-operative societies and co-operative banks
Non-teaching staff in private educational institutions, including tutorials and computer coaching centres
Paper and paper board (including straw board and handmade paper)
Any manufacturing process in a factory not otherwise listed
Hostels of colleges and other educational institutions
groups.note: The first ten were added to the scope in 2026 (Schedule I); the rest are Schedule II. Schedule II lists sales promotion twice (entries 44 and 67), counted once here. Schedule III of the order sorts job titles into the four skill levels.

The order leaves these piece-rated and labour-intensive employments to a separate committee under section 8(1)(a) of the Code on Wages. No committee rates had been published when we checked, and the order supersedes the old notifications, so there are no current rates to show.

verification: 2026-11-24: publication check for the owner's go-ahead. G.O. 6 downloaded again from the Government Orders portal itself (30052026LETF_MS6.PDF, 252,621 bytes, 10 pages): SHA-256 9607b5ae…01b2, identical to the United Consultancy copy we cite and host. GOIR searches of LETF and SHAKTI, MS and RT orders for 2026 (wages, minimum, Code on Wages, dearness, cost of living, zone, labour code, rules) find G.O. 6 as the only wage order; nothing amends, clarifies, suspends or withdraws it. SHAKTI MS orders listed for 2026: No. 14 (14 August, unrelated), No. 16 (5 October, 'Not Issued'), No. 18 (14 November, final Platform Based Gig Workers Rules); Nos. 15 and 17 are not on the portal.

2026-11-24: High Court, read from the court's own records (causelist.tshc.gov.in case lookup; orders from csis.tshc.gov.in/hcorders). W.P.(PIL) No. 14 of 2023 (CNR HBHC010140352023), Telangana Regional Trade Union Council v. State of Telangana: pending at admission. IA 2/2026 (to suspend G.O. 6) and IA 3/2026 (to suspend 'Gazette No 111A, dated 01 06 2026 published the G O Ms No 6') were filed on 4 August 2026 and are pending, with no order on either; IA 1/2026 (to amend the prayer) is also pending. Filings since: the State's counter affidavit (19 August), the State's memo (20 August), the petitioner's reply affidavit (8 September), a posting slip (9 October). Heard with W.A. No. 717 of 2026 (Telangana State Multiple Contractors Labour Union, an appeal against the 19 June 2026 recall of the 2024 directions in W.P. No. 34997 of 2022) and C.C. No. 2624 of 2023 (contempt).

2026-11-24: High Court orders, Division Bench of the Chief Justice and Justice G.M. Mohiuddin. 20 July 2026 (W.A. 717, 206200007172026_1.pdf, sha256 d0551934…): the State said that since the Code on Wages took effect on 21 November 2025, 'the notifications revising the wages have been issued … by Gazette Notification dated 01.06.2026'; the court stayed further proceedings in W.P. No. 34997 of 2022. 4 August 2026 (206400000142023_9.pdf, sha256 b5b74353…): the State said a notification was issued on 30 May 2026 with effect from 1 June 2026; listed for 20 August, 'no further time would be granted'. 20 August 2026 (206400000142023_10.pdf, sha256 e0114170…): a week for the petitioner's reply affidavit; the interim order in W.A. 717 continues. The only interim order in the three cases is that stay of W.P. 34997 of 2022; nothing suspends G.O. 6. The cases were last listed on 20 November 2026 (items 39 to 41 before the Acting Chief Justice's bench); no order from that day was uploaded by 24 November and none of them is on the 23 or 25 November lists. The monitor now watches all three case records daily.

2026-11-24: Gazette. The Telangana e-Gazette lists Part I extraordinary issues 111, 111-B, 111-E and 111-F around 1 June 2026, but not 111-A, 111-C or 111-D, so the issue the court filings cite cannot be read there; a search of all 764 extraordinary entries from 20 May to 14 November 2026 has no wage, minimum rates, Code on Wages or cost of living entry. We rely on the State's statement to the High Court (20 July 2026) and the petitioner's IA 3/2026 for publication on 1 June 2026, and cite the gazette as not available online.

2026-11-24: VDA. labour.telangana.gov.in/MinRatesWages.do: newest folder 01042026 (old-structure sheets), no 01102026 folder; no cost of living circular on the home page; GOIR has no dearness or cost of living order. Two HR trackers (secondary) list Telangana's 1 October 2026 revision as due and not notified. The page shows the basic rates alone, as before; no VDA figure is shown.

2026-11-24: State rules. The Code on Wages (Telangana State) Rules, 2026 are still a draft: the department hosts the draft (code_on_wages_state_draft_rule_2021.pdf, last modified 6 June 2026, sha256 32e023d3…) and the minutes of the June 2026 stakeholder meetings (MoM_Code_Wages_Rules.pdf, sha256 a9daba4d…), where unions asked for the zones to be removed and AITUC said G.O. 6 was issued without consulting them or the Advisory Board. No final rules found. In the Assembly (LAQ 2402, answered 10 September 2026; papers in G.O.Rt. No. 362, SHAKTI, 30 September 2026) the Labour Minister said the revised wages took effect from 1 June 2026 under G.O. 6 (reported by The Rahnuma Daily; secondary).

2026-11-24: Published (owner, 24 November 2026: publish Telangana's reference pages with the Hyderabad business pages). Basis: G.O. 6 is in force, was published in the extraordinary gazette of 1 June 2026 on the State's own statement to the High Court, and no court order suspends it; the page says the suspension applications are pending and that no VDA has been declared. Still open: a named checker; the outcome of the 20 November 2026 hearing; the 10% protection clause (para 5(4) and (10)), not worked out on the page; rates for the 8 committee employments.

2026-11-19: hand check after the monitor's first listing read (4 November 2026) counted every link as new. labour.telangana.gov.in/MinRatesWages.do has 1,218 links: 1,183 wage sheets in 15 period folders from 1 April 2017 to 1 April 2026, the newest still 1 April to 30 September 2026 (74 sheets), plus 35 CPI gazettes, guideline G.O.s, contract labour VDA circulars (newest 1 October 2024 to 31 March 2025) and notes; there is no folder for 1 October 2026, and 451 older links (1 October 2020 to 1 October 2023) return 404. The home page's newest wage item is the minutes of the June 2026 consultations on the draft state rules; no final Code on Wages rules. SGCMS's newest Telangana wage post is G.O. 6 (1 June 2026). G.O. 6 re-downloaded with matching sha256. Nothing changes; the 1 October 2026 cost of living allowance is still not declared.

2026-10-27: G.O.Ms. No. 6, LET&F (Lab-I), 30 May 2026, read from the United Consultancy copy (252,621 bytes, 10 pages, text layer). SHA-256 9607b5ae…01b2 matches the file the Government Orders portal (goir.telangana.gov.in, department LETF, type MS, 2026) serves. Figures read from Table 1: per month, Zone I / II / III: unskilled 16,000 / 15,000 / 14,000; semi-skilled 17,000 / 16,000 / 15,000; skilled 18,500 / 17,500 / 16,500; highly skilled 20,000 / 19,000 / 18,000.

2026-10-27: Para 1(c): basic rates linked to the consumer price index at 443 points (2001 = 100); ₹33.86 a month per point above 443; cost of living allowance declared every 1 April and 1 October. Para 5: monthly ÷ 26 for a day's wage, rest day included; trainees 75%, not below unskilled; overtime and rest-day work at double rate; pay rounded to the nearest 50 paise; principal employer responsible for a contractor's workers.

2026-10-27: Para 5(4) and (10): where existing notified wages are higher, a 10% enhancement over them applies, and anyone already paid more keeps it. The order does not say whether 'existing wages' means basic or basic plus VDA under the old notifications, or which old category maps to which skill level, so the page does not work out the 10%.

2026-10-27: Labour Department (labour.telangana.gov.in/MinRatesWages.do) still lists only the old-structure wage sheets, the latest for 1 April to 30 September 2026 under the 2012 notifications (e.g. any manufacturing process, G.O.Ms. No. 4: unskilled 13,686 at index 1,995). G.O. 6 supersedes them from 1 June 2026, so they are not shown. No 1 June or 1 October 2026 sheet or VDA notice is listed; SGCMS and AscentHR have no Telangana VDA post for October 2026.

2026-10-27: Court challenge: the order is 'subject to outcome of pending W.P's, and CCs' before the Telangana High Court (a batch from a 2023 PIL by trade unions). News reports (siasat.com) record a hearing on 4 August 2026 giving the State a final chance to file an affidavit, listed for 20 August 2026; no later outcome found. The page stays in review until someone signs off its status.

2026-10-27: Gazette: the order directs an Extraordinary Gazette of 1 June 2026. The Telangana eGazette list (tggazette.cgg.gov.in) shows no minimum wage entry between 29 May and 5 June 2026; publication unconfirmed.

2026-10-27: The department was renamed SHAKTI (Skill, Human Capital and Knowledge Training Initiatives) around July 2026; new orders are listed on GOIR under that name. G.O.Ms. No. 16 (SHAKTI, Labour-I, 5 October 2026) is listed as 'Not Issued'.

2026-10-27: Schedule II has 67 entries, with sales promotion at both 44 and 67; 66 distinct employments plus Schedule I's 10 = 76. Para 3's committee list has 8 employments plus 'any other industry the government adds'.

2026-10-31: court status update (news reports, not primary). Siasat (20 June 2026): on 19 June 2026 Justice Nagesh Bheemapaka allowed the State's review of the 2024 orders that had directed it to gazette five 2021-22 wage G.O.s, on the ground that the Code on Wages replaced the Act, and closed the unions' contempt petitions. Newsmeter and Siasat (4 August 2026): a Division Bench (Chief Justice Aparesh Kumar Singh and Justice Ghouse Meera Mohiuddin) heard the Telangana Regional Trade Union Council's PIL, where counsel argued G.O. 6 was issued without inviting objections; the State was given a final chance to file an affidavit, listed for 20 August 2026. No report of that hearing or later, and no stay of G.O. 6, found. GOIR (LETF and SHAKTI MS and RT orders to 16 October 2026) and labour.telangana.gov.in/MinRatesWages.do show no newer wage order and no 1 October 2026 VDA. G.O. 6 re-downloaded with matching sha256.

2026-11-01: Telangana eGazette (tggazette.cgg.gov.in, homeAllGazetteSearch?type=1: every extraordinary gazette, 7,915 rows, newest 26-Oct-2026, 113 to 158 a month through 2026) lists no minimum wage or Code on Wages notification after the 30 January 2024 revisions. The Labour, Employment, Training and Factories entries for 2026 are the gig workers rules (2 June), Ease of Doing Business (25 June), appointments, shops exemptions and a medical officers list; nothing on or near 1 June 2026, the date G.O. 6 directs for its extraordinary gazette. Titles in the listing are truncated, so a gazette worded without wage in its first 45 characters could be missed. Read with the department page still showing the 1.4.2026 sheets, G.O. 6 does not appear to have been gazetted; the page stays in review.
